criteria.demonstration: Four actual typed read functions preserve pointed-to const/volatile and expose distinct category markers, while generic selection chooses function designators before evaluating the single call argument. Typed write and observation APIs have narrower qualifier sets and no erased default. Retained numeric generic producer and MOD9/10 controls are actually imported and exercised.

criteria.criterion: Distinguish top-level pointer qualifiers from pointed-to const and state the compatible-type association restrictions. The controlling expression is not evaluated; only the selected call argument is evaluated. Explain why the generic selection should choose valid function names rather than embed branch-specific invalid field operations.

criteria.demonstration: Exact N1570 generic/qualifier passages and the N2243 DR481 C17-marked corrigendum were read. Executed GCC/Clang probes distinguish top-level pointer const from pointee qualification and array decay. Nine negative translation specimens per compiler include unsupported/const writes, invalid unselected expression, duplicate compatible association, VLA/function association, discarded volatile and wrong device-view type. Explicit casts compile only and are not executed through an invalidly unqualified volatile-defined object. Published C17/C23 remain inaccessible.

criteria.demonstration: Required volatile transfer includes distinct ordinary read/write-mask update and write-one-to-clear command views. Host synthetic RAM observes command values, never claims hardware clearing. Actual GCC assembly and Clang host/M4 O0/O3 IR show one-load/one-store update, store-only ack and two callback-separated reads; two M4 ELF32 links have zero undefined/dynamic imports and are explicitly not executed. Callback lifetime, const-view alias limits, no implicit atomicity/barrier and all13cost dimensions are explicit. Delayed author support is implemented without claiming independent learner/physical review.

limits: Valid qualified live objects, disjoint outputs and externally serialized access are premises.
Volatile is neither atomic synchronization nor an ISA/device barrier; callback lifetime is explicit.
M4 links and emitted access observations are not target or physical execution.
Published C17/C23 remain inaccessible; no physical result or independent human review.
